accepted_findings.reason: Slice AN1 centralizes protected Analytics reporting and CSV export queries so visible metrics and export rows share one normalized filter contract.
Slice AN1 rebuilds the protected Analytics admin view with selected-range filters, revised sections, denied voucher type display, and a top-filter-only export form.
Slice AN1 routes Analytics AJAX and CSV export through the shared Analytics service while preserving existing accounting/admin permission checks.
Slice AN1 loads the shared Analytics service during plugin bootstrap.
Slice S1 support change only passes optional manual manager code from existing admin AJAX into the protected manager model.
Slice S1 copy-only update changes the manager-code validation message from 6-digit to 4-character.
Slice C0 adds the authoritative Release C product contract as documentation-only planning input.
Slice C0 records that S5 visual and interaction decisions remain binding while the single-voucher backend assumption is superseded.
Slice C0 documents the C1-C5 dependency order and Release C cross-slice hard stops.
Slice C1 adds request-group, group-delivery, voucher-type capability schema, and nullable voucher request_group_id linkage.
Slice C1 recognizes the explicit household_goods root type while preserving legacy household-as-furniture normalization and reads delivery fee configuration for future calculations.
Slice C1 introduces the backend-only atomic request group service for one to three child vouchers and one group-level delivery snapshot.
Slice C1 introduces voucher-type delivery capability settings used by future request-group delivery decisions.
Slice C1 loads the new backend service classes and localizes the configured delivery fee with the existing default.
Slice C2 adds schema version 11 with Household Goods browse group, catalog, and configuration audit tables plus starter catalog seed data.
Slice C2 introduces the Household Goods catalog, limit, request-line snapshot helper, active/archive validation, and configuration audit service.
Slice C2 adds explicit Household Goods catalog, limit, and configuration-audit capabilities for administrators.
Slice C2 adds nonce-protected AJAX endpoints for Household Goods browse group, category, and limit administration.
Slice C2 adds capability-gated navigation for the Household Goods administration tab.
Slice C2 adds the Household Goods admin UI for browse groups, categories, limits, and read-only configuration audit.
Slice C2 adds admin-side AJAX flows for Household Goods create, update, archive, restore, reorder-by-sort-order, and limit updates.
Slice C2 loads the Household Goods catalog service during plugin bootstrap.
Slice C3 adds schema version 12 with shared requested-line, fulfillment-entry, unavailable-reason, fulfillment-audit, voucher finalization note, and receipt path persistence.
Slice C3 introduces the shared Furniture and Household Goods fulfillment service for Save Progress, Finalize Voucher, validation, document generation, and audit rows.
Slice C3 adds cashier-facing status precedence, shared fulfillment state formatting, finalization-note fields, and expired-voucher ordinary redemption guard.
Slice C3 preserves legacy Furniture workflow while blocking ordinary mutation/completion for dynamically expired unredeemed vouchers.
Slice C3 calculates invoice totals from shared fulfillment entries when present while preserving legacy Furniture item totals.
Slice C3 passes structured unavailable reasons to the shared fulfillment detail and filters cashier cards by resolved display status.
Slice C3 loads the shared fulfillment service and registers protected Save Progress and Finalize Voucher REST endpoints.
Slice C3 adds inline shared fulfillment row management, calculated totals, Save Progress, Finalize Voucher submission, and validation.
Slice C3 keeps the legacy cashier card renderer compatible with new cashier-facing READY TO REDEEM, REDEEMED, and EXPIRED status fields.
Slice C3 makes cashier cards show large status labels, date support text, and non-color cues while preserving card architecture.
Slice C3 routes line-backed Furniture and Household Goods vouchers to the shared fulfillment workspace while preserving legacy Clothing and Furniture paths.
Slice C3 updates legacy Furniture detail to use cashier-facing status labels without changing historical item-resolution behavior.
Slice C3 adds the one-screen fulfillment workspace for requested lines, multiple price rows, unavailable quantities, internal finalization note, Save Progress, and Finalize Voucher.
Slice C3 renders shared fulfillment receipt outcomes without prices, internal finalization notes, or staff-only unavailable reason details while preserving legacy Furniture receipt behavior.
Slice C3 renders shared fulfillment invoice rows with actual fulfilled values while preserving legacy Furniture invoice behavior.
Slice P1 adds schema 13 editable Furniture categories, unified Household Goods pricing, configurable limits, and immutable pricing snapshots.
Slice P1 adds audited, conflict-guarded Furniture category administration and defaults range display to Up to.
Slice P1 adds fixed/range retail pricing, organization coverage, adjustable limits, validation, and snapshot data.

Slice P1 unifies priced catalog cards, conditionally renders inline category context, supplies shared pricing-type-aware organization payment copy, and enforces zero-as-unlimited Household Goods limits.
Slice P1 implements the shared responsive three-line catalog card, segmented quantity-control presentation, and theme-isolated public builder width and typography boundary.
Slice P1 adds editable Furniture category controls and the unified fixed/range pricing administration fields.
Slice P1 implements nonce-protected Furniture category mutations, stale-edit handling, and unified pricing form behavior.
Slice P1 adds unified Household Goods pricing fields and administrator-adjustable selected-category and total-quantity limits.
Slice P1 implements the Household Goods pricing and limit administration interactions for the protected catalog surface.
Slice A1 adds idempotent monthly reconciliation, statement delivery, QuickBooks IIF/manifest packages, bookkeeping email, and accounting audit.
Slice A1 builds an allowlisted, price-free approved-voucher DTO and protects on-demand print access.
Slice A1 adds schema 14 organization billing mappings, statement delivery/export metadata, accounting batches, and accounting audit.
Slice A1 adds the limited SVdP Bookkeeper role and svdp_manage_accounting capability.
Slice A1 loads accounting/print services, schedules reconciliation, and registers protected handlers.
Slice A1 renders a cashier-authorized neighbor copy containing approved quantities and no pricing or accounting data.
